actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology.

dimensions.assessment: Affects regional economic development organizations, venture development organizations, startup businesses, and communities participating in innovation initiatives, including rural and economically distressed areas.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall conduct outreach to encourage participation in regional innovative initiatives... in rural communities

dimensions.assessment: Alters program rules, cost-share limits, and funding allocations to support regional innovation ventures and capital access.
dimensions.evidence: The Federal share of the cost of any activity funded under this subsection shall not exceed 50 percent, plus an additional amount that shall not exceed 40 percent

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $50,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2030 and authorizes the use of unobligated funds from previous fiscal years.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to carry out this section $50,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2030.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Stevenson-Wydler Technology Innovation Act of 1980 by modifying definitions, cost-sharing structures, and interagency collaboration requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Section 27 of the Stevenson-Wydler Technology Innovation Act of 1980 (15 U.S.C. 3722) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Provides authorization of appropriations and programmatic authorities spanning five fiscal years from 2026 through 2030.
dimensions.evidence: appropriated to the Secretary to carry out this section $50,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2030.

missing_information: Actual amounts of unobligated funds available from previous fiscal years are not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill reauthorizes the regional innovation program (Build to Scale) under the Stevenson-Wydler Technology Innovation Act of 1980 at $50,000,000 annually for fiscal years 2026 through 2030 and modifies cost-share and outreach rules.
